text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're late, Trainer! I was just about to
come get
you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. What a good trainee, right?
Amazing,
right? Go on, shower me with
praise!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I got a good night's sleep, so I was up
early today!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So I'm all ready for today's training!
Come on,
let's go! ♪
